statement: US forces strike at least one target on Iranian soil, mainland or islands, between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if a CENTCOM statement, or reporting by both Reuters and AP, confirms a US strike on a target on Iranian soil, mainland or islands, carried out between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: US forces carry out no strike on any target on Iranian soil, mainland or islands, between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine (HRMMU) reports at least 300 civilians killed in Ukraine during the event window 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if the HRMMU monthly protection of civilians update covering November 2026 states at least 300 civilians killed in Ukraine between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: The verified civilian death toll in Ukraine for 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 is below 300.

statement: At its scheduled meeting concluding 2026-12-09, the FOMC raises the federal funds target range by at least 25 basis points, lifting the upper limit to 4.25 percent or higher. Reference: upper limit 4.00 percent at seal.
resolution: True if FRED series DFEDTARU shows 4.25 or higher for 2026-12-10, reflecting the FOMC decision of 2026-12-09. Reference: 4.00 percent at seal.
failure_condition: The FOMC decision of 2026-12-09 leaves the upper limit of the target range at 4.00 percent or lower.

statement: The S&P 500 closes below 7,000.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 7,405.12 on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series SP500 records any daily close below 7000.00 dated from 2026-11-09 through 2026-12-31. Reference: 7405.12 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every S&P 500 daily close from 2026-11-09 through 2026-12-31 is at or above 7000.00.

statement: CISA adds CVE-2026-123158, the OpenSSH password-authentication bypass affecting musl-based Linux systems without PAM, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-06 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog carries CVE-2026-123158, the bypass fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2, with a dateAdded value from 2026-11-06 through 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: CISA does not add CVE-2026-123158 to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-06 and 2026-12-31.

statement: CISA adds a vulnerability in D-Link DGS-3130 Series switches to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendorProject D-Link naming DGS-3130 in its product or vulnerabilityName field, with a dateAdded value from 2026-11-06 through 2027-01-29.
failure_condition: CISA does not add any D-Link DGS-3130 vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-29.

statement: Pete Hegseth leaves the post of US Secretary of Defense, also styled Secretary of War, by resignation, dismissal or removal between 2026-11-09 and 2027-02-26.
resolution: True if, between 2026-11-09 and 2027-02-26, Hegseth resigns, is fired or is removed from office, as announced by the White House or reported by both Reuters and AP.
failure_condition: Hegseth remains in office, having neither resigned nor been fired or removed, throughout 2026-11-09 to 2027-02-26.

statement: At the Victorian state election held on 2026-11-28, the Liberal-National Coalition wins at least 45 of the 88 Legislative Assembly seats.
resolution: True if Victorian Electoral Commission declared results for the 2026-11-28 election show Liberal and National candidates winning a combined 45 or more of the 88 Legislative Assembly seats.
failure_condition: Liberal and National candidates win a combined 44 or fewer of the 88 Legislative Assembly seats at the 2026-11-28 election.

statement: Between 2026-11-09 and 2027-01-08, a government of an EU member state or the UK publicly attributes the November 2026 hoax bomb threats against European flights to Russian state actors or their proxies.
resolution: True if, between 2026-11-09 and 2027-01-08, an EU member-state or UK minister, or national police or intelligence agency, says Russian state actors or proxies were behind the hoax threats, per Reuters or AP. Suspicion alone fails.
failure_condition: No EU member-state or UK minister, national police or intelligence agency attributes the hoax bomb threats to Russian state actors or proxies between 2026-11-09 and 2027-01-08.

statement: Delhi records an official daily AQI of 401 or higher, the Severe band, on at least one day between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-22.
resolution: True if the CPCB 4 PM National AQI Bulletin lists Delhi at 401 or higher for any date from 2026-11-09 through 2026-11-22.
failure_condition: The CPCB daily AQI for Delhi stays at 400 or below on every day from 2026-11-09 through 2026-11-22.
